items.title: Ike Robertson Interview, 1961-04-28
items.q: But you're read by Margetts, Imitating Lewis and other different fellas.

ctx.x: Some people told me in The Careless Love, he plays some of those same chords.
He's a perfect idea to play just like Chris Kelly. But you're read by Margetts, Imitating Lewis and other different fellas. I guess that would sport his list. Howard was a pretty good trumpet player.
Did Kid Howard ever play drums with you when you were playing with Chris?
